integrity: Full definitions, finite certificate, and limiting proof are included. The cited prior joint law is explicitly acknowledged and no independent scientific audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact cyclic-set distribution is classical. The claim is limited to uniform random labeled mappings and to a sharp dependence-sign and negative-association classification. An exact finite range is checked by bundled rational arithmetic and the remaining infinite range is proved by an analytic bound. Earlier implicit coverage in general mapping literature is possible.
title: Sharp negative-dependence phases for cyclic vertices of uniform random mappings
